title: 12 Best Rio de Janeiro Street Food
description: Explore Rio's best street food! Discover iconic açaí, savory pastéis, legendary hot dogs, and unique Amazonian bites. Your guide to 12 top street food spots in Rio de Janeiro.

places.name: Barraca da Cida
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Pastel de Carne com Queijo (beef and cheese pastel) or Pastel de Camarão (shrimp pastel)

places.name: Açaí do Chico
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Açaí na Tigela (açaí bowl) with granola, banana, and guaraná syrup

places.name: Cachorro Quente do Gaúcho
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Cachorro Quente with everything: mashed potatoes, corn, peas, vinaigrette, and catupiry cheese

places.name: Feira de São Cristóvão
places.priceRange: BRL 30-70 ($6-14) per person for a full meal
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Baião de Dois (rice and beans with cheese and dried meat), Carne de Sol com Macaxeira (sun-dried meat with cassava), or a fresh Tapioca

places.name: Bibi Sucos
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Suco de Abacaxi com Hortelã (pineapple with mint juice) or a hearty Açaí bowl

places.name: Tacacá do Norte
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Tacacá (a hot soup made with tucupi, jambu, and dried shrimp) and Pato no Tucupi (duck in tucupi sauce)

places.name: Bar do Oswaldo
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The classic Caipirinha de Limão (lime caipirinha) or a refreshing Caipirinha de Maracujá (passion fruit)

places.name: Ponto do Pastel
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Pastel de Palmito (heart of palm pastel) or a classic Coxinha de Frango (chicken croquette)

places.name: Coxinha da República
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The classic Coxinha de Frango com Catupiry (chicken and creamy cheese coxinha)

places.name: Quiosque da Célia
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Tapioca recheada (stuffed tapioca) with cheese and coconut, or a fresh água de coco (coconut water)

places.name: Talho Capixaba
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Pão de Queijo (cheese bread) and a gourmet coxinha or empada

places.name: Barraca do Pescador
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Espetinho de Camarão (shrimp skewer) or a grilled peixe (fish) of the day, with a fresh Água de Coco (coconut water)
